# Saffron Table: hours, location and booking rules

Address: 12 Cardamom Lane, Shoreditch, London

## Opening hours

All times are London time, on a 24-hour clock.

- Monday: closed
- Tuesday to Sunday: lunch 12:00-15:00, dinner 17:30-22:30

Closed every year on these dates, whatever the weekday: 1 January, 25 December and 26 December.

## Last seating

A booking holds its table for the whole sitting, so the sitting must finish by closing
time. The last seating is closing time minus the sitting length: the latest a party can
be seated.

| Party size | Sitting | Last seating |
|---|---|---|
| 1 to 4 | 90 minutes | lunch 13:30, dinner 21:00 |
| 5 to 8 | 120 minutes | lunch 13:00, dinner 20:30 |

## Tables and party size

- 4 tables seating 2
- 4 tables seating 4
- 1 table seating 6
- 1 table seating 8

Tables are never combined. The largest table seats 8, so a party of more than 8 cannot be booked by phone. The agent takes a message for the events team instead.

## Booking rules

- Bookings can be made from 15 minutes from now, up to 60 days ahead.
- Start times fall every 15 minutes.
- Changing or cancelling a booking needs the booker's name and phone number.
